workspace_edit.label: Edit the community
workspace_edit.description: Change the community''s name, description, photo, rules, visibility and who may join.

workspace_usage_view.label: View usage and storage
workspace_usage_view.description: See member, channel and file storage figures.

workspace_delete.label: Delete the community
workspace_delete.description: Permanently delete the community and its channels.

workspace_transfer.label: Transfer ownership
workspace_transfer.description: Hand ownership of the community to another member.

members_view.label: View the member list
members_view.description: Browse and search everyone in the community.

members_invite.label: Invite people
members_invite.description: Create invitations for members and guests.

members_invites_manage.label: Manage all invitations
members_invites_manage.description: See and revoke invitations created by anyone.

members_roles.label: Change member access
members_roles.description: Switch people between Member and Guest.

members_titles.label: Edit titles
members_titles.description: Change the short title shown next to members'' names.

members_remove.label: Remove people
members_remove.description: Remove members and guests from the community (they can come back with an invitation).

members_ban.label: Ban people
members_ban.description: Remove people and keep them out until the ban is lifted, and see the ban list.

members_timeout.label: Time out people
members_timeout.description: Stop someone posting, sharing files and joining voice channels for up to 28 days.

members_approve.label: Approve applications
members_approve.description: Approve or deny people who applied to join.

members_nickname.label: Change your nickname
members_nickname.description: Pick the name you go by in this community.

members_nicknames.label: Manage nicknames
members_nicknames.description: Change or clear other people''s nicknames in this community.

roles_view.label: View roles
roles_view.description: See the community''s roles and what each one allows.

roles_manage.label: Create and edit roles
roles_manage.description: Create, edit, clone and archive custom roles (only with powers you hold).

roles_assign.label: Assign roles
roles_assign.description: Give custom roles to people and take them away (only roles within your own powers).

roles_delegate.label: Delegate admin powers
roles_delegate.description: Put administrative powers into roles and assign such roles.

channels_view.label: See channels
channels_view.description: See the community''s public channels and be in them. Channel and category permissions can take it away.

channels_create.label: Create channels and categories
channels_create.description: Create channels, voice channels, forums and categories.

channels_manage.label: Manage channels
channels_manage.description: Rename, reorder, move, archive and manage the members and permissions of channels and categories.

channels_visibility.label: Change channel access
channels_visibility.description: Make any channel public, private or announcement-only.

webhooks_manage.label: Manage webhooks
webhooks_manage.description: Make, rename and delete channels'' webhooks, give them new addresses and post through them.

messages_post.label: Post in channels
messages_post.description: Send messages in the community''s channels.

messages_attach.label: Share files
messages_attach.description: Send photos, videos, voice messages and files in channels.

messages_announce.label: Post announcements
messages_announce.description: Post in announcement channels, where only managers can post.

messages_bypass_slowmode.label: Skip slowmode
messages_bypass_slowmode.description: Post without waiting in channels with slowmode on.

messages_react.label: Add reactions
messages_react.description: React with a new emoji. Without it, people can still join reactions already on a message.

messages_embed.label: Post links
messages_embed.description: Send messages with web links and link previews.

messages_voice.label: Send voice messages
messages_voice.description: Record and send voice messages in channels.

messages_external_emoji.label: Use emoji from other communities
messages_external_emoji.description: Use emoji and stickers that belong to other communities.

messages_polls.label: Create polls
messages_polls.description: Ask a question with answers people vote on.

messages_big_text.label: Write headings
messages_big_text.description: Start a line with #, ## or ### to make it a big heading.

messages_mention_all.label: Mention everyone
messages_mention_all.description: Notify a whole channel with @everyone, and mention any role, even one that isn''t open to mentions.

messages_manage.label: Manage messages
messages_manage.description: Delete and pin anyone''s messages in channels, and post without waiting in slowmode.

messages_history.label: Read earlier messages
messages_history.description: See what was said in a channel before you joined it. Without it, only messages from after joining show.

threads_create.label: Start threads
threads_create.description: Begin a thread from a message in a channel.

threads_post.label: Reply in threads
threads_post.description: Send messages in threads that already exist, and in forum posts.

threads_manage.label: Manage threads
threads_manage.description: Delete and pin anyone''s messages inside threads.

expressions_manage.label: Manage emoji and stickers
expressions_manage.description: Upload, rename and remove the community''s own emoji and stickers.

voice_connect.label: Join voice channels
voice_connect.description: Join the calls in voice channels.

voice_speak.label: Speak in voice channels
voice_speak.description: Talk, share video and share the screen in voice channels. Without it, people listen only.

voice_mute_members.label: Mute people in voice
voice_mute_members.description: Mute someone in voice channels until you unmute them: they can listen but not talk or share.

voice_move_members.label: Disconnect people from voice
voice_move_members.description: Take someone out of a voice channel''s call.

audit_view.label: View the audit log
audit_view.description: See every administrative change in the community.

reports_view.label: Handle reports
reports_view.description: See what members reported to the moderators, and close reports.

moderator.name: Moderator
moderator.description: Keeps conversations healthy: manages channels and their access, posts announcements, times out, removes and bans people.

community_manager.name: Community Manager
community_manager.description: Grows the community: invites people, sets up channels and categories, keeps titles right.

read_only.name: Read-Only Member
read_only.description: Reads channels but can''t post or share files in them.

welcomer.description: Welcomer says hello to each person who joins, in the channel you pick, so nobody arrives to silence. Write the greeting yourself and drop in their name, the community''s name or how many people are here now.
welcomer.limit_0_plus: Up to 10, one picked at random

helper.description: Helper keeps a few party tricks ready in every channel it can post in: dice, a coin, a fortune ball and a picker for when nobody can decide. People can leave an away note too, and Helper answers for them while they''re gone. Nothing to set up.
helper.command_0: A yes-or-no question for the fortune ball
helper.command_1: Roll dice (a d6 unless you say otherwise)
helper.command_4: Leave an away note until you''re back
helper.command_5: Every command the bots here know

levels.tagline: XP for chatting, levels for regulars
levels.description: Levels hands out a little XP when people chat (once a minute at most, so spamming gets nowhere) and cheers when someone goes up a level. !rank shows where you stand and !top the ten most active. Its leaderboard can go on your lobby too.

logger.tagline: A quiet record of what changed
logger.description: Logger writes one short line into the channel you choose for every edit, deletion, join, leave, kick, ban, timeout and role change, and never pings anyone. It stays quiet until you pick its channel: a private one is best, so only your team reads it.
logger.limit_0_what: Member events in their own channel

starboard.tagline: The best messages, picked by everyone
starboard.description: When enough people react to a message with ⭐ or 🌟, Starboard copies it to your starboard channel with a link back and keeps its star count up to date. Your own stars don''t count, private channels are skipped, and no message goes up twice.

giveaways.description: Giveaways runs a prize draw from a single message. Anyone who manages messages in a channel can start one there: people react 🎉 to enter, and when time''s up the bot draws the winners from people still in the community and calls them out. Bots never win, and running draws show on your lobby.
giveaways.command_0: Start a draw here (s, m, h, d or w)
giveaways.command_1: Three winners, drawn in two hours
giveaways.command_3: Draw someone else for the last one
giveaways.limit_2_what: Only members with a role can win

tickets.tagline: Private help desks for your members
tickets.description: Tickets posts a panel with an "Open a ticket" button. Each ticket is a private channel between the person who opened it and your moderators, and either side closes it once it''s sorted. Turning Tickets on here is the same switch as Settings › Tickets.
tickets.limit_2_what: A support role that sees tickets and is pinged
tickets.limit_3_what: Welcome line in each new ticket
tickets.limit_4_what: Transcript in the log when closed

alerts.description: Alerts follows the YouTube channels you add and posts each new upload in the channel you pick, with a ping for a role if you like. It looks every ten minutes and only ever posts videos that came out after you added the channel.

wordy.description: Wordy picks the same five-letter word for everyone here each day (new at 00:00 UTC). You get six tries, the board shows colours but never letters, and Wordy keeps streaks, the best solvers and a recap of yesterday in its channel.
wordy.command_0: Start or show your game of the day
wordy.command_1: Guess (or just type a five-letter word in Wordy''s channel)
wordy.command_2: Your streak and the best solvers here

plus.description: Every official bot''s Plus extras, for this whole community.
plus.perk_0: Up to 10 greetings and a goodbye
plus.perk_5: Bigger, longer giveaways for a role
plus.perk_6: 10 ticket panels with support roles and transcripts
